name: Wyoming Authentic Beef
old_description: We do too! Each bag of our whole-muscle Angus Beef Jerky proudly displays the name of the Wyoming Ranch where the beef was locally sourced and is made with just 9 ingredients or less. Taste the Wyoming difference for yourself!
about:
Wyoming Authentic Beef operates from Cody, Wyoming, producing whole-muscle Angus beef jerky and snack products. The company does not disclose its founding year or founders' names in the provided materials, nor does it specify an ownership structure such as family-, veteran-, or woman-owned. Its origin story centers on a commitment to transparency: each package bears the name of the Wyoming ranch where the cattle were raised.

The company manufactures grass-fed, all-natural beef jerky, beef sticks, and beef bites in flavors including Original, Peppered, Honey, Sweet & Spicy, Cowboy Hickory Smoked, Wild Ginger, Original Jalapeño, Honey BBQ, and Fired Up Jalapeño. Products are formulated with nine ingredients or fewer — the Sweet & Spicy jerky uses seven — and contain no added hormones, antibiotics, MSG, nitrites, nitrates, or artificial ingredients. No facility size, headcount, equipment list, or production volumes are published.

Wyoming Authentic Beef sells directly to consumers through its e-commerce site, offering free shipping on U.S. orders over $75 (excluding Alaska and Hawaii). No wholesale, foodservice, or industrial customers are identified in the source material.

The brand differentiates itself through ranch-level traceability, minimal-ingredient recipes, and a stated "Code of the West" ethos emphasizing courage, fairness, and keeping promises. These values, rather than certifications or technical capabilities, form the core of its market positioning.
